lines.say: Hurt in a crash? McMinn Law Firm has a few things to tell you first.
The adjuster may text you within days. Can we get a recorded statement? We can offer two thousand today.
Before you answer, do four things: see a doctor, take photos, keep every bill, and call before you sign.
You don't have to handle the insurance company alone. Talk to our team today.
